business_summary: Aisan Technology Co.,Ltd. designs, develops, sales, and support CAD systems for the public survey, land registration surveying, civil engineering, and construction industries in Japan. The company offers surveying/registration comprising ANIST, creating floor plans; ANIST-Modeler, reduce 3D modeling effort by utilizing point cloud and topographic map data; WingNeoINFINITY; ATM'S Home; GrandBase, a 3D design data tool for roads and flat areas; and LASPORT, a land system port. It also provides MMS/point cloud services, which includes WingEarth, a point cloud processing tool; mobile mapping system; and MMS post-processing solution. In addition, the company offers mobility solutions including high precision 3D map data and position solutions, 3D data processing software, autonomous driving system development and smart city solution, and other solutions, such as drone surveying solution, and HandzReco, a character recognition engine; and DEXIO, visualize and utilize of 3D spatial information through digital twin. Aisan Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
